cases.name: seedsigner_coin_128flips_asked_24w_refusal
cases.reason: 128 flips cannot produce 24 words on SeedSigner — coin flips. SeedSigner — coin flips sets word count from the flip count: 128 flips -> 12 words, 256 flips -> 24 words, and it refuses any other pairing. This tool refuses the same inputs the device refuses, on purpose.
